entries.note: The sender's data, before DPD has the parcel.
An earlier wording of the sender's data. Seen in archived replies of the tracker.
The sender's data, before DPD has the parcel. Seen in archived replies of the tracker.

entries.wording: Customer dropped parcel at Pick Up Point
entries.note: The sender left the parcel at a Pickup shop.

entries.wording: Your parcel has been collected from the Pickup Point
entries.note: A Pickup shop handing the parcel over. After the sender's drop-off at the shop it is DPD's collection, in transit; otherwise it may be the recipient's collection, so it has no stage of its own and the parcel keeps the one it had.
A driver's collection. Its stage depends on the scans before it: it accepts the parcel from the sender, and after an earlier acceptance or movement it is a hand-over in transit.

entries.wording: Your parcel is travelling through the DPD network
entries.note: A hub or line-haul scan, usually under Head Office.
A scan in another DPD country's network, at a place named with its country.
A parcel from DPD's UK network arriving at an Irish depot.
Leaving the hub. Seen in archived replies of the tracker.
A depot scan before delivery. Seen in archived replies of the tracker.
Seen in archived replies of the tracker, on parcels from outside the EU.

entries.wording: Your parcel is on a van and due for delivery
entries.note: The history cuts the delivery window after this wording, and the parser removes it; the headline gives the whole window.

entries.wording: We tried to deliver but you weren't home
entries.note: Seen in archived replies of the tracker, with a link to rearrange the delivery.

entries.wording: Delivery of your parcel has been rescheduled
entries.note: A new delivery day, not a movement: it has no stage of its own and the parcel keeps the one it had. Seen in archived replies of the tracker.
An earlier wording of a delivery. Seen in archived replies of the tracker.
Left in the recipient's safe place. Seen in archived replies of the tracker.
